script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The joke imagines Jesus as a priest waiting for a shift. Humor must not target Jesus.
The hiking boot joke doesn't connect to an action in the passage. A mountain is mentioned, but no one is hiking.
The line about tent poles presents a detail about the true tabernacle that the passage does not give.
The full-crew comparison suggests Jesus is not needed as an additional priest. The passage instead describes His more excellent ministry.
The bakery photo joke makes a comparison with the place where the priests serve. Holy things are not to be the joke.
The eyeballing joke makes light of building the tabernacle, a holy thing.
It says the covenant itself is not treated as an issue, but verse 7 speaks of the first covenant not being without fault.
Jeremiah 31:31 does not establish that the words were first spoken through Jeremiah. Saying he was not one of those at fault also goes beyond what the text says.
Saying the laws go on the inside 'this time' implies they had not been there before. The passage does not say that.
Remembering sins for a season would mean remembering them for a time, not that they would come back later.
The explanation simply repeats the answer and ends with a generic line. It has little of Papa Dorin's voice.
